teaser: Working on the newsroom solved RiskMandate's oldest problem in two days: progress is not a straight line, and the thinking is never wasted.
core_idea: Focus on one thing only assumes progress is a straight line; focus instead means undivided attention on the place of highest leverage, the one with users and feedback loops; the newsroom had the momentum to solve the master vault problem that had resisted six months of RiskMandate attempts, solving it in two days with a passkey and a door per path; it is also building the agentic workflows and the public behaviour-policy example RiskMandate needs; and its history, The Cyber Boardroom and MyFeeds, both paused, shows the thinking is never wasted when it is written down and open source.

nodes.label: Progress is not a straight line
nodes.summary: Focus-on-one-thing advice assumes the shortest path to a goal runs through that goal; it often does not.

nodes.label: Undivided attention on the place of highest leverage
nodes.summary: One thing at a time, chosen because it has users and feedback loops now.

nodes.label: Am I getting better?
nodes.summary: The measure: are we discovering new capabilities, at the altitude that leads to other things.

nodes.label: Six months on the master vault, then two days
nodes.summary: Attempts failed the simplicity test; the newsroom's passkey and door per path solved it, and it applies to RiskMandate.

nodes.label: Do not solve a problem without the momentum to need it
nodes.summary: RiskMandate's volumes let it hand users their keys; the newsroom's readers on every device made the vault urgent.

nodes.label: The newsroom is RiskMandate's workflow
nodes.summary: Agentic follow-ups, outreach and publishing: an effective newsroom is an effective CRM and publishing pipeline.

nodes.label: A public example customer work cannot be
nodes.summary: This site's agents run under a behaviour policy in the open, the example of ABPs and licences to operate RiskMandate needs.

nodes.label: The Cyber Boardroom
nodes.summary: Personas and customised output with an advisor called Athena; paused for want of a place to keep confidential data, which sgit now is.

nodes.label: MyFeeds
nodes.summary: Personalised feeds on semantic graphs from article to persona; paused when the industry was silent and micropayments were not there.

nodes.label: The writing stays
nodes.summary: The 2025 pieces on trust, provenance and micropayments are what the newsroom stands on.

nodes.label: Going back with an end-to-end example
nodes.summary: Content, graphs, meter, personas, micropayments and a vault per reader, running and open source; if not 2026, then 2027.

nodes.label: The thinking is never wasted
nodes.summary: Written down and open, the thinking survives a pause and is there when the moment comes.

quotes.text: A problem solved before anybody needs it is solved in the abstract, and abstract solutions are where the complexity creeps in.
quotes.why: Why RiskMandate could not solve the master vault and the newsroom could.

quotes.text: I could argue that while I was working on the newsroom, I was working on RiskMandate.
quotes.why: The non-linear sequence in one sentence.
